description: A company in the desert can transport goods to rural cities either by camel caravans or desert trucks. A camel caravan can deliver 50 units of goods per trip and takes 12 hours. A desert truck can deliver 150 units of goods per trip and takes 5 hours. However, due to the cost of fuel, the company prefers to have more camel caravans than desert trucks.  If the company needs to deliver 1500 units of goods, how many of each method of transportation should the company organize to minimize the total number of hours required?

CamelCaravanCapacity.definition: Amount of goods delivered per trip by a camel caravan

CamelCaravanTime.definition: Time taken for one trip by a camel caravan

DesertTruckCapacity.definition: Amount of goods delivered per trip by a desert truck

DesertTruckTime.definition: Time taken for one trip by a desert truck

TotalGoodsToDeliver.definition: Total amount of goods to be delivered

objective.description: "Minimize the total number of hours required to deliver 1500 units of goods"

constraints.description: The total amount of goods delivered by camel caravans and desert trucks must be at least 1500 units
The numbers of camel caravan trips and desert truck trips must be non-negative integers

numCamelCaravans.definition: Number of camel caravan trips organized

numDesertTrucks.definition: Number of desert truck trips organized
